headline: 7 Michigan deals, $1.2M raised — led by Park Place Capital LLC

top_deals.summary: Park Place Capital LLC, a Traverse City-based lodging and conventions company, filed a $10.2M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $1.1M sold to 2 investors.
Park Place Capital GP, LLC, a Traverse City-based lodging and conventions company, filed a $1.9M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $0 sold.
Dynamic Aerospace Systems Corp, an Ann Arbor-based manufacturing company, filed a $750K equity and security to be acquired offering under Rule 506(b); $100K sold to 1 investor.

notable_ma.summary: Anthony DiGiandomenico reported a 9.9% stake in ENDRA Life Sciences Inc. (NDRA) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 1).

material_agreements.summary: Gentherm Inc (THRM) entered into a material definitive agreement (credit facility).
Jackson Financial Inc. (JXN) entered into a material definitive agreement (credit facility).
Shoulder Innovations, Inc. (SI) entered into a material definitive agreement (credit facility).

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $1.2M sold across 3 Form D filings this week, down 99% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Park Place Capital LLC (Traverse City, Lodging and Conventions) targeting $10.2M. Good question to ask: are founders in travel & hospitality favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

Anthony DiGiandomenico reported a 9.9% stake in ENDRA Life Sciences Inc. (NDRA) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 1). Schedule 13D filers can push for strategic change, so it's worth asking whether shareholders see a sale or restructuring on the table.
Manufacturing & Automotive was the most active sector with 2 of 7 filings (29%). Ask contacts what's driving the activity, and whether it's showing up in their pipeline.
